_comment: Tool-agnostic MCP server definitions, stowed to ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json.
This is the shared source: pi's built-in MCP support reads it through the
shell/.pi/agent/mcp.json symlink, and anything else honoring the tool-agnostic
location reads it here. opencode keeps its own copy in
~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc -- add a server there too. Claude Code and
Codex keep theirs in machine-local files; run mcp-install after editing this
file to register every server here in both.
Secrets never belong here: this repo is public. Remote servers authenticate
interactively (pi: /mcp or pi mcp login <name>; opencode: opencode mcp auth <name>).
description is pi-only: it lists the server in pi's system prompt and ranks its tools.

obsidian.description: Personal Obsidian vault: search, read, and edit notes.
